changes: Auto-Party Mode: (Bugfix) Skip now only enables when your queue pops for an MSQ duty in a premade party of 4, and disables when you leave the instance.
Auto-Party Mode: Unrestricted Party queues into Castrum Meridianum, The Praetorium, or Porta Decumana now always enable the skip regardless of party size.
Submarine & Workshop: (Bugfix) Signature Hook has been corrected to properly skip the cutscenes.
World Cutscenes: (Bugfix) Ocean Fishing cutscenes will no longer be accidentally skipped by this category (See Risky Skips Category instead).
IPC: GetSkippedCategories now returns SkippedCategory[] (enum) instead of string[].
UI: Clicking the label next to any checkbox now toggles the skip just like when clicking the checkbox itself.
UI: The MSQ Roulette Status circle now turns yellow when Auto-Party Mode is active.
UI: Reduced Minimum Size and added a scrollbar to the category list.
